lead.title: Moove raises $250M to become the backbone of the robotaxi industry
lead.summary: The autonomous-mobility infrastructure company closed a $250M Series C at a $2.1B valuation, backed by Mubadala, Toyota and Uber. Moove already operates Waymo's Phoenix robotaxi fleet and is moving to own robotaxis outright.

top_stories.title: 224 Ventures launches with $100M to back AI-native startups, backed by LeCun and Vinyals
top_stories.summary: Shaun Johnson, Yann LeCun and Oriol Vinyals launch a $100M AUM technical and go-to-market-focused venture firm writing $1-5M checks in applications, robotics, infrastructure and core intelligence.

top_stories.title: AntLingAGI releases open weights for Ling-3.0-flash, a 124B MoE built for production agents
top_stories.summary: Ant Group's model ships with hybrid-linear attention and 1/64 sparsity, trained on 10,000+ interactive environments, with LMSYS shipping day-0 SGLang support that cuts TTFT by 60-80%+ on long agent runs.

items.title: MultiPathFormer: a foundation model for multipath wireless propagation
items.summary: A wireless foundation model pretrained to model multipath propagation for channel estimation, beam prediction and localization, showing strong generalization across wireless sensing tasks.

items.title: Protoreasoning in tiny transformers
items.summary: Shows that roughly 1M-parameter transformers can benefit from a simple Chain-of-Thought form, enabling detailed analysis of step-by-step reasoning at a scale far smaller than frontier models.

items.title: Trident: how to break deep RL cyber defenses
items.summary: An adaptive agentic red-team that breaks Deep RL-based autonomous cyber defense systems, which are typically only evaluated against static heuristic attackers.

items.title: Privileged, but biased: how PI-conditioned teachers break self-distillation
items.summary: Analyzes how privileged-information-conditioned self-teachers provide dense per-token supervision, exposing failure modes of compute-efficient self-distillation as an alternative to verifiable-reward RL.

items.title: Training-free hashing-based attention via binary principal components
items.summary: A training-free sparse attention method using hashing on binary principal components to accelerate long-context decoding without KV-cache reprocessing cost.

items.title: Kimi K3 reaches frontier-class performance as an open-weights model
items.summary: Moonshot AI's open-weights Kimi K3 is touted as reaching frontier-class multimodal and agentic performance, with Together AI leading or tying for #1 on OCRBench, MMMU Pro Vision and DeepSWE.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash hits 82.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, beating V4 Pro Preview with 1/5 the parameters
items.summary: Highlighted by Together AI, DeepSeek's smaller V4 Flash outpaced its larger V4 Pro Preview (72.1) while using roughly one-fifth the total parameters, continuing the V4 line's extreme parameter efficiency on agentic and coding benchmarks.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 with MoonViT vision (NVFP4)
items.summary: A quantized NVFP4 build of DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 adds MoonViT vision support, targeting lower-footprint multimodal inference for the V4 Flash line.

items.title: Avnet and Weston Robot partner to launch edge AI inspection platform
items.summary: The tech distributor and robotics integrator bring Physical AI to industrial environments via quadruped robots with AMD-powered edge computing for real-time monitoring.

items.title: Why Nvidia stock rallied today
items.summary: Shares rose after Elon Musk said SpaceX will exclusively buy Nvidia AI chips, reinforcing Nvidia's position as sole AI silicon supplier to another major customer.

items.title: University of Florida opens robotics lab for industrialized construction
items.summary: Fueled by Autodesk, the Smart Industrialized Construction Lab will train students on construction processes using robots to address housing shortages and labor declines.

items.title: Sapiom raises $35M Series A for cost-aware agent infrastructure
items.summary: Sapiom ships a cost-aware model router, an Agent Studio, and a Runtime with typed step graphs and full traces, letting agents pay for search, scraping and model calls mid-run.

items.title: Mirafold: generative UI for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI
items.summary: A generative UI framework that lets coding agents in Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI render interactive interfaces from natural language.

items.title: Bifrost: enterprise MCP gateway with OAuth 2.0 and RBAC
items.summary: An open-source Model Context Protocol gateway for enterprises bundling built-in OAuth 2.0 and role-based access control to centralize and secure MCP tool access.

items.title: Sift: MCP aggregator exposing 2 tools instead of hundreds
items.summary: An MCP aggregator that consolidates a large set of Model Context Protocol tools into a single unified interface of two tools, reducing tool-discovery burden on agents.

items.title: Simon Willison ships major update to the llm CLI and Python library
items.summary: The llm CLI and library gained reasoning traces, OpenAI Responses API support, server-side tools, improved logging and broader LLM compatibility.
